# Roblox

> Roblox is a user-generated content platform hosting millions of multiplayer games across genres, from survival and horror to RPGs and puzzle games.

Roblox provides game discovery tools including trending charts, live player count tracking, and curated spotlights to help players find popular and emerging games. The platform emphasizes multiplayer experiences across diverse genres including action, casual, strategy, and narrative-driven titles.

## Key Topics

- Game Discovery
- Trending Games
- Multiplayer Gaming
- Free-to-Play
- RPG/MMORPG
- Horror Games
- Survival Games
- Party & Casual Games
- Puzzle Games
- Strategy Games
- Live Player Counts
- Popular Games
- Roblox Platform
- Game Recommendations
- Co-Op Gaming

## Game Charts & Discovery

- [Most Popular Games on Roblox](https://www.roblox.com/charts/top-playing-now): Track most popular Roblox games with live player counts
- [Trending Survival Games on Roblox](https://www.roblox.com/charts/trending-in-survival): Browse trending survival games on Roblox platform
- [Trending Party & Casual Games on Roblox](https://www.roblox.com/charts/trending-in-party-and-casual): Discover trending party and casual games on Roblox
- [Trending Puzzle Games on Roblox](https://www.roblox.com/charts/trending-in-puzzle): Browse trending puzzle games on Roblox platform
- [Trending Strategy Games on Roblox](https://www.roblox.com/charts/trending-in-strategy): Browse trending strategy games on Roblox platform

## Curated Game Spotlights

- [Roblox Horror Games: Best Multiplayer & Co-Op Picks](https://www.roblox.com/spotlight/horror): Curated horror game recommendations: Doors, Piggy, Dandy's World
- [Roblox RPG Games: Best Action & MMORPG Picks](https://www.roblox.com/spotlight/roleplaying-games): Top RPG picks: World // Zero, Dungeon Heroes, Deepwoken
